recap: Day 1 (June 25, 2026) introduced Safeeely - an AI-escrow bot for DM deals (social media sales, freelance gigs, crypto) used via Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp/Instagram/Apple bots under a 'safetag' handle - and covered two serious milestone (pay-in-phases) money bugs found and fixed on day one. Days 2-4 (June 26, 2026) chased a WhatsApp notification bug through three layers, shipped a 'resume TXN-CODE' cross-platform command, and fixed a milestone phase-numbering bug in emails. Day 5 (also June 26, 2026) swapped placeholder payment icons for real brand logos, broke and then fixed the platform-fee display in the same cleanup pass. Day 6 (June 27, 2026) shipped a huge solo admin-dashboard expansion in one sitting - ten new back-office pages (fraud queue, workload-balanced dispute assignment with 24h/72h SLA escalation, finance dashboards, marketplace moderation, referrals, broadcast messaging, analytics) - then spent the same day firefighting a build-breaking TypeScript error and an admin auto-logout bug caused by a login cookie scoped to a different domain than the page checking it, fixed by carrying the JWT in localStorage instead. Next chapter continues deeper into the admin panel's rollout (a full redesign + test suite lands June 30).
